objective: Declare sign-up and sign-in for the Nerdery wildlife application through the DNR identity service, feature first through OV3's own changes: nerdery-register-wildlife-user and nerdery-sign-in-wildlife-user, each with capability-from-dsl, which binds the retained bytes of its canonical feature and commits only when the check finds the binding CONFORMANT; prove each stored document is exactly the reviewed one by its digest.

steps.historicalBasis: the wildlife capabilities were declared this way by capability-from-dsl (flight 9810b9af, the photo flight and the catalog flight, plan sha256:0442d1cb); this DSL compiles COMPILED to sha256:8d80e177396ad14f72b937aab911022b68f12b34b25fcd03628a9b8c21f389d9 against the retained bytes of its feature with the installed compiler (read-only run 1dd86a71), and its operation's mechanics met every case of that feature read-only (runs 8a8f1f45, 59995dd3, e8a9ae1e, d6230231)

payload.source:
capability nerdery-sign-in-wildlife-user
feature nerdery-sign-in-wildlife-user sha256:bf9ff42f4a1c96eec6cb938f3bf40e57b8c13aed9b94e4a64dc73f90b6250cd6
intent: Sign in to the wildlife application, for the caller whose session the declared API operation verified (Nerdery wildlife application)
outcome: nerdery-sign-in-wildlife-user-result.v1 SIGNED_IN or REFUSED, each refusal named by its reason code, so that I can use my own collection and team
input contract nerdery-sign-in-wildlife-user-request.v1 {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["request"],"properties":{"caller":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"principalId":{"type":"string"},"sessionId":{"type":"string"}}},"request":{"type":"object"}}}
output contract nerdery-sign-in-wildlife-user-result.v1 {"type":"object","additionalProperties":true,"required":["contractId","status"],"properties":{"contractId":{"const":"nerdery-sign-in-wildlife-user-result.v1"},"status":{"enum":["SIGNED_IN","REFUSED"]}}}
cli display outcome as json
scenario nerdery-sign-in-wildlife-user root terminal
given: a DNR sign-in response reference
when: the wildlife sign-in is completed
then: the user has an authenticated application session or a named sign-in refusal
operation nerdery-sign-in-wildlife-user.sign-in uses provider sql-database-reader
config: {"dataSource":"sfx-identity-database","statement":"EXEC wildlife.serve @operation=N'nerdery-sign-in-wildlife-user',@input=@input;","resultColumn":"value"}
input input from nerdery-sign-in-wildlife-user $
outcome from nerdery-sign-in-wildlife-user.sign-in $.value

payload.source:
capability nerdery-register-wildlife-user
feature nerdery-register-wildlife-user sha256:24ce719da85308c66551cae6d5f38a8477765ebff52dd7308e68db2dd7e0c666
intent: Register a wildlife user through the DNR identity service, for the caller whose session the declared API operation verified (Nerdery wildlife application)

given: a DNR registration response reference
when: the wildlife account registration is completed
then: the user has one wildlife account or a named registration refusal
operation nerdery-register-wildlife-user.register uses provider sql-database-reader
config: {"dataSource":"sfx-identity-database","statement":"EXEC wildlife.serve @operation=N'nerdery-register-wildlife-user',@input=@input;","resultColumn":"value"}
